summary: Nutrition sync reads every zero-based page from USDA's foods/list endpoint and reports whether the effective key is personal or the public DEMO_KEY.
reason: The foods sync used an unpaged, ID-required endpoint and its page counter skipped page one; a whitespace-only or public DEMO_KEY value could also be reported as a personal credential.
validated_outcome: Regression tests assert foods uses page pagination and DEMO_KEY remains usable without being reported as a configured credential.
